title: State of New Jersey Common Pension Fund D Trims Stake in Apple Inc. (AAPL)
text:
Posted by ABMN Staff on Jan 10th, 2019 // No Comments
State of New Jersey Common Pension Fund D reduced its stake in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 4.1% during the 3rd quarter, according to the company in its most recent 13F filing with the SEC. The institutional investor owned 4,115,000 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 175,000 shares during the quarter. Apple accounts for 3.4% of State of New Jersey Common Pension Fund D’s holdings, making the stock its 3rd biggest holding. State of New Jersey Common Pension Fund D owned approximately 0.08% of Apple worth $928,920,000 as of its most recent filing with the SEC.
Other institutional investors and hedge funds also recently added to or reduced their stakes in the company. Kessler Investment Group LLC boosted its stake in Apple by 24.9% in the third quarter. Kessler Investment Group LLC now owns 29,416 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $6,640,000 after buying an additional 5,864 shares in the last quarter. Zweig DiMenna Associates LLC boosted its stake in Apple by 2.4% in the third quarter. Zweig DiMenna Associates LLC now owns 63,068 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $14,237,000 after buying an additional 1,500 shares in the last quarter. Security National Bank boosted its stake in Apple by 2.1% in the third quarter. Security National Bank now owns 75,235 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $16,983,000 after buying an additional 1,579 shares in the last quarter. Private Capital Advisors Inc. boosted its stake in Apple by 13.3% in the third quarter. Private Capital Advisors Inc. now owns 85,440 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $13,168,000 after buying an additional 10,047 shares in the last quarter. Finally, Lawson Kroeker Investment Management Inc. NE acquired a new stake in Apple in the third quarter valued at about $201,000. 57.06% of the stock is currently owned by institutional investors. Shares of AAPL stock opened at $153.31 on Thursday. The company has a market capitalization of $728.72 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 12.87, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.38 and a beta of 1.23. The company has a quick ratio of 1.09, a current ratio of 1.12 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87. Apple Inc. has a fifty-two week low of $142.00 and a fifty-two week high of $233.47.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last issued its earnings results on Thursday, November 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.91 earnings per share for the quarter, topping the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $2.78 by $0.13. The business had revenue of $62.90 billion during the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $61.55 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 48.68% and a net margin of 22.41%. The firm’s revenue for the quarter was up 19.6% on a year-over-year basis. During the same period in the previous year, the company posted $2.07 earnings per share. On average, research analysts anticipate that Apple Inc. will post 12.13 earnings per share for the current year.
In other Apple news, insider Chris Kondo sold 3,408 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction that occurred on Monday, November 19th. The stock was sold at an average price of $190.00, for a total value of $647,520.00. Following the completion of the sale, the insider now owns 8,940 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $1,698,600. The sale was disclosed in a legal filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is available at this hyperlink . Company insiders own 0.06% of the company’s stock.
AAPL has been the subject of several research reports. Macquarie reiterated a “buy” rating and issued a $214.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, September 12th. UBS Group initiated coverage on Apple in a research report on Wednesday, September 12th. Nomura reiterated a “neutral” rating and issued a $185.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research report on Monday, November 5th. HSBC downgraded Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating and dropped their target price for the company from $200.00 to $160.00 in a research report on Wednesday. Finally, Robert W. Baird reiterated a “buy” rating and issued a $235.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research report on Monday, September 24th. Three analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-six have assigned a hold rating and twenty-two have assigned a buy rating to the stock. The company presently has a consensus rating of “Hold” and an average target price of $195.19. Apple Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers. It also sells various related software, services, accessories, and third-party digital content and applications. The company offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers, as well as iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS operating systems.
